verdict.rationale: Mastra's workflow engine lets steps call agents (mastra-docs-37), and its `.then()`, `.branch()` and `.parallel()` control flow (mastra-gh-3, mastra-docs-36) means several agents can be composed inside one workflow. However, nothing in the pack documents agent-to-agent handoffs, supervisor/subagent patterns, or crew-style agent networks, so multi-agent orchestration is only implied by step composition. missing for 10: explicit handoff or subagent/supervisor primitives, documented multi-agent network or crew abstractions, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-agent orchestration.
